description: Grades work with calibrated answers on your own TypeSafe key, and reads the judge's decisions. For proving a chain fact use taifoon_prove. Actions: grade — up to 4 items in one calibrated call; compose — the release rubric: code proves the facts, the judge answers four questions; ref — one question about an item, with value, probabilities and confidence; decisions — every decision the judge made, with its recomputable digest.

action.description: what to do (default grade): grade | compose | ref | decisions

answers.description: mode answers: id → { value, confidence, probabilities } for each of the four questions prepare returned (actions: compose)

id.description: one decision id, for its full record and calldata (actions: decisions)

record.description: where the decision and its answers are also written on chain: none (default: receipt and digests only), devnet (free), base, or the name or chain id of any live network, or a list of them; GET /v1/judge/record/networks lists the live networks with the price of a record now. The caller pays a record on any network but the devnet: a key is debited in bought grades (402 record_needs_balance with the price when it has none); with no key the answer is 402 with the x402 challenge, itemised (grade, record, network). A network that is not live answers 400 record_network_not_live with the live ones (actions: compose)

trading.description: a trading epoch to grade: { mandate: { markets[], venues[], period { from, to }, max_order_size, max_notional, max_position, allow_short?, kind?, owner?, attribution? }, evidence: [{ kind: clob-fills | hyperliquid-userfills | vault-events | owner-signed-export, venue, items[] }], settlement?, stepper?, submitted? }; code runs the class checks (each kind's reader verifies what it can), then Jev answers over those facts (actions: compose)

name: taifoon_grade
title: Grade a delivery
